description: Rewrite PdfFile with cFile+Companion pattern, implement LicenseController fully, fix isLicenseValid return type, add checkLicense scheduled job, fix updateRemoteSourceSub signature, wire RemoteWebview into adapters, update CI workflow
steps: Rewrite src/main/java/io/legado/app/model/localBook/PdfFile.kt to use cFile+Companion pattern matching JAR: class PdfFile(book: Book) with instance fields (book, info: Map, cover: InputStream?), instance methods (parseBookInfo(), upBookInfo(), updateCover(), getContent(chapter), getChapterList(), getChapterListByPage(), getChapterListByOutline(), processOutline(doc, chapters, outlineNode)). companion object with: private var cFile: PdfFile? = null, synchronized fun getPdfFile(book: Book): PdfFile (creates/reuses cFile), fun getChapterList(book: Book): ArrayList<BookChapter>, fun getContent(book: Book, chapter: BookChapter): String?, fun upBookInfo(book: Book, isRefresh: Boolean = false).

Rewrite src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/LicenseController.kt to match JAR structure: (1) Add fields: private val webClient by lazy { SpringContextUtils.getBean(...) }, private var privateKeyContent: String? = null, private var tryCodeCache: ACache (initialized with ACache.get(...)), private val backupFileNames by lazy { listOf('bookSource','bookshelf','bookmark','replaceRule','rssSource','bookGroup','httpTTS') }. (2) Change isLicenseValid to: suspend fun isLicenseValid(context: RoutingContext): ReturnData that returns ReturnData with license validity info (always valid in community mode). (3) Change checkLicense to: suspend fun checkLicense(license: License) that validates license (no-op in community). Keep all existing endpoint methods but ensure they use the new fields where appropriate.

In src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/YueduApi.kt: (1) Add router.get('/reader3/isLicenseValid').coroutineHandler { licenseController.isLicenseValid(it) } route. (2) Add a @Scheduled checkLicense() method that periodically validates the license (calls getInstalledLicense and verifies - no-op in community mode). Place it alongside other @Scheduled methods.

In src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/controller/BookSourceController.kt, change updateRemoteSourceSub signature from fun updateRemoteSourceSub(userNameSpace: String) to suspend fun updateRemoteSourceSub(userNameSpace: String, user: com.htmake.reader.entity.User? = null) to match JAR signature. The user parameter can default to null for backward compatibility. Update the caller in YueduApi.kt remoteBookSourceSubUpdateJob to pass null or construct a User.

In src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/init/ReaderAdapter.kt, update getStrResponseByRemoteWebview to delegate to RemoteWebview.getStrResponse when AppConfig.remoteWebviewApi is configured. Import RemoteWebview and AppConfig, check if remoteWebviewApi is non-empty, and call RemoteWebview.getStrResponse with the parameters.
In src/main/java/io/legado/app/adapters/DefaultAdpater.kt, update getStrResponseByRemoteWebview to also delegate to RemoteWebview.getStrResponse (same pattern as ReaderAdapter).

Update .github/workflows/pull-request.yml to: (1) trigger on 'opened' event type in addition to existing types. (2) Remove the condition that checks github.repository == 'hectorqin/reader'. (3) Simplify the build step to just run ./gradlew compileKotlin (no need for web build or jar assembly for PR checks). Keep Java 8 setup.
acceptance_criteria: PdfFile uses cFile+Companion pattern with class (not object), has getChapterList(Book), getContent(Book, BookChapter), upBookInfo(Book, Boolean) on Companion
LicenseController has privateKeyContent, tryCodeCache, backupFileNames fields, isLicenseValid returns ReturnData
YueduApi has checkLicense @Scheduled method and isLicenseValid route
ReaderAdapter and DefaultAdpater delegate to RemoteWebview when configured
pull-request.yml triggers on opened PRs and runs ./gradlew compileKotlin
findings: PdfFile rewritten with cFile+Companion pattern; Book.kt updated to use PdfFile.upBookInfo(this) instead of parseBookInfo with InputStream; LocalBook.kt updated to use PdfFile.getChapterList(book) and PdfFile.getContent(book, chapter) without InputStream params; LicenseController backupFileNames made public val (auto-generates getBackupFileNames getter matching JAR); ACache.get takes (cacheName, maxSize, maxCount) overload; checkLicense scheduled job added to YueduApi with 6-hour interval.
